title: Planned removal: PDF over 2,000 rows is refused, the CSV has every row
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in to ShopView as an Admin user.
  • On today's date A/P Aging Detail has more than 2,000 document lines (the organization with about 13,000 open A/P lines qualifies). If an A/R report in your organization has more than 2,000 lines, you may use it instead for steps 2 to 9.
  • Write down the five bucket counts shown in brackets.
  • On today's date A/R Aging Detail has fewer than 2,000 lines.
custom_steps:
1. Open the Reports menu.
  2. Click "A/P Aging Detail" in the left list.
  3. Click the Export menu.
  4. Click "Download (PDF)".
  5. Read the message.
  6. Click the Export menu.
  7. Click "Download (CSV)".
  8. Open the downloaded file in a spreadsheet.
  9. Count the document rows (leave out the heading lines and the Totals row).
  10. Click "A/R Aging Detail" in the left list.
  11. Click the Export menu.
  12. Click "Download (PDF)".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 5:

  • PRD v12, S3-N1, quoted: “Over 2,000 rows, the PDF is refused before anything is generated: no download, and the message "This report is too large for PDF. Export it as CSV, or narrow the filters, then try again." Exactly 2,000 rows is allowed.”
  • Step 5 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): No PDF downloads and the quoted message shows. Before the release the A/R reports printed a PDF of any size (the A/P reports had no PDF at all).
  • Step 9 (our restatement, not the PRD's words): The CSV holds one row per document; the count equals the sum of the five bucket counts.
  • Step 12 (unchanged from before the release): A/R Aging Detail, under 2,000 lines, still gives a PDF, as its print did before the release.
  • Related existing case: DATA-18 C715467 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715467); DATA-20 C715469 (https://shopview.testrail.io/index.php?/cases/view/715469). This case checks the same planned change from the before-the-release side.

Why this matters: Large aging must still be obtainable in full, as CSV, even though the PDF is now capped.

SOURCE: A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S3-N1. V1 behaviour before the change: ShopView/shopview at fc08f23 (production v26.45.3), api/src/Reporting/Dashboard/Application/AccountReceivable/Pdf/AgingDetailPdfQueryHandler.php:27-75; app/src/components/ts/reporting/accounts-payable/ApAgingSummaryReport.vue:35-47.

This is the expected behaviour as per the A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter PRD (Confluence 947650561) v12, 12 Nov 2026, S3-N1, for epic SV-11315; the V1 behaviour it changes is recorded in AR-AP-V1-BASELINE.md (INV-078). Last checked against build v26.45.4-b8c04e2 (staging) on 11/12/2026.

AUTOMATION: READY
